title: Top up the operator key of metal0
lead: One transaction from your wallet on Base. Check the amount and the data on the Trezor screen before confirming. This page never signs or sends anything by itself.

steps.title: Send 0.001 ETH to the operator key
steps.why: The host’s operator key pays the registry transaction that every start of its supervisor needs (until it lands the host neither claims nor renews its apps) and the proof-of-time checkpoints. It only ever pays gas. Lease claims and renewals are paid from the apps’ gas, not from this key. The key is delegated (EIP-7702) to the lease executor, which refuses a plain transfer, so the wallet will show a contract creation instead: its data is 73, then the recipient’s address, then ff, which hands the amount to that address and leaves nothing deployed.

show.Recipient: 0xC9D0835Cd8eBc7eaE84304d9DB0A76253EebE6aB (the operator the registry records for this host)
show.Delegate: 0x8900baca2167873ba2f8a8bae8b4876e6396d343 (no payable entry: a plain transfer reverts)
show.Simulated: on 2 RPCs the recipient’s balance rises by exactly the amount; 60957 gas
